description: Figure 10 is a line plot that illustrates the model's Eval Perplexity (PPL) under different sparsity settings applied to the Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) components at varying ratios. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 25 to 100, with major tick marks at 25, 50, 75, and 100. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", is also a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with major tick marks at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, and 14.0. The plot displays four distinct lines: the "Transformer" model is represented by a red dashed line, which remains flat at a PPL of 11.75 across all ratios. The "Only MoHD FFN" model is shown as a grey line with square markers, which starts at a PPL of approximately 11.75 at 100% ratio and decreases to about 11.7 at 25% ratio. The "Only MoHD ATTN" model is depicted by a dark blue line with circle markers, which starts at a PPL of approximately 11.75 at 100% ratio and increases to 14.0 at 25% ratio. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" model is represented by a light blue line with star markers, which starts at a PPL of approximately 11.75 at 100% ratio and increases to about 13.1 at 25% ratio.
